bottom_line: All 1,608 lots were scanned with every photo viewed, blind rescored, and 132 candidates got a market pass with an Opus check. This time Gowans' own past results were the first source for every lot, so most maximum bids rest on what this room actually pays. It is a solid but modest sale: the best-supported picks are a Giant carbon full-suspension 29er (lot 1341), a run of gold rings and pieces with plenty of Gowans comps (lots 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10), a Victorian cedar secretaire bookcase (461), an original Xbox Crystal (769), six teak dining chairs (721), six 1966 round 50c coins (123) and a bag of watches with two Omega quartz pieces (171). The biggest unknown is lot 1408, a Giant Trance X Advanced Pro 29 carbon trail bike: no Gowans sale to compare, so no maximum bid, but worth a close look at inspection. Absentee bid counts were refreshed on Wednesday evening and will keep rising until Friday. Online absentee bids close at 9:30 AM Friday.
assumptions: All 1,608 lots in the auction were taken from Gowans' public API and image store and scanned with every photo viewed. None was unscanned.

This is a live room auction. The site shows no prices, only a count of absentee bids on each lot (refreshed Wed 14 Oct, evening), so no current bid is used. Scoring is blind to price. The bid count shows interest, not how high bids go.
Buyer's premium is 19.8% including GST on the hammer price for all lots except vehicles, per the auction's own notice. All-in = hammer x 1.198.
Candidates with a blind score of 4 or more (132 lots) got a market pass. Other candidates and the lots the scan skipped appear in the table of every lot with a photo finding and a reason.
Gowans past results come from Gowans' public lot API, where sale_price is in cents and read as the hammer price (premium extra); dates are listing dates, about a week before each sale.

Other sold prices come from auction and marketplace data (PriceCharting for games and toys, popsike for hi-fi and others) that may not say whether premium is included. Maximum bids use only sold prices in the last 24 months.

Gold and silver weights, carat marks and maker claims in the titles are catalogue claims. Check weights and hallmarks at the inspection. Melt value is a floor, not a sale, so it never sets a maximum bid.
Pickup from 37 Main Road, Moonah. Inbound freight is assumed to be $0 because you are local.
Sources closed to this session (eBay, Wine-Searcher, Australian Whisky Auctions) were not used directly.
